integrity: Complete deterministic exact arithmetic over the 1152-element type-F4 Coxeter group; reproducibility code and its output are embedded; no independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the ordinary geometric quotient of the type-F4 proper noncrossing partition order complex under Coxeter conjugation, not homotopy or Borel quotients. Exhaustive exact finite enumeration verifies its homology; shellability and Armstrong orbit-group theorem yield the homotopy type. It does not classify arbitrary Coxeter types. Prior-equivalence risk remains for unindexed literature.
title: A twelve-sphere wedge from Coxeter-conjugation on the type-\(F_4\) noncrossing complex
